title: Test net carbon delivery against one shared full-voltage leakage allowance
statement: For the source stated flux directions at one common membrane cross-section,D=A-B-N-L and W_cell=FU(2A-B+O)/D. The resulting shared leakage inequality is a common-operating-state gate,not a transport-law approximation.

evidence.quote: ### 2. Measured forward and backward fluxes give an exact operating gate
evidence.range_scope: Exact operating gate for stated measured flux pattern at one common cross-section and full terminal voltage;not a linear-law assumption.

requires: At ONE common cross-section let A be forward carbonate carbon,B backward bicarbonate carbon,N backward neutral carbon,L unrecovered external carbon,and O other forward charge in electron equivalents. Use the source sign pattern and nonnegative named loss terms;D=A-B-N-L>0.
U is FULL terminal voltage,not membrane potential,half-cell voltage or an activation-only drop. Set b=B/A,n=(N+L)/A,o=O/A,X=FU,with A>0. W_max and X use the same energy/mol units.
provides: Exact source bookkeeping W_cell=FU(2A-B+O)/(A-B-N-L). W_cell<=W_max is equivalent to (W_max-X)b+W_max n+Xo<=W_max-2X with b+n<1.
At U=0.150V and W_max=35kJ/mol,the source rounded gate is20.5272 b+35 n+14.4728 o<=6.0544. All leakage spends the SAME allowance,not independently available budgets.
The gate does not assume a linear transport law. The same measurement must establish adequate absolute delivered flux after all-area and duty corrections.
assumptions: Restricted to the stated observed flux species,directions and terminal-work accounting;additional carriers,carbon pathways or external operations require their own consistently included terms.
Cell-work allowance leaves explicit room for all remaining plant operations;passing this inequality does not earn the full target.
costs: Forward and reverse carbon/charge must be measured at compatible operating conditions,along with full terminal voltage,absolute delivered carbon,area and complete operating duty.
contract.units: A,B,N,L carbon fluxes on one common basis;O electron-equivalent flux;FU and W_max J/mol or consistently kJ/mol.
contract.obstruction: Backflow,neutral loss,external unrecovered carbon and OH/other charge consume one budget;low membrane resistance alone does not control charge per delivered carbon. No matched membrane operating intersection is supplied.

body: Producer reports a nonlinear counterexample to treating a linear Onsager energy floor as universal. That limitation is retained;the present flux/voltage identity does not inherit a universal linear-response lower bound.
